items.summary: First public release candidate: route map separating open sessions, buffered playout, and local short-clip workflows.
Added a dated source-backed research report with price, hardware, and continuity limits.
Added FastH3 local MLX and DGX Spark route conditions, source timing conversions, and the full-quality versus preview-decode boundary.
Added the distinction between a paced continuous broadcast and hard-cut independent FastH3 scenes, plus qualified local-H3 access conditions.
Added FastH3’s manual-default versus optional-autoplay playout boundary, a current Director price-expiry warning, and fresh longform-local and workflow-version conditions.
Corrected the FastH3 high-end timing into separate four- and eight-B200 conditions, updated Director to its current list price, and added a condition-rich local 5090 signal.
Added a condition-bound consumer FastH3 channel report: the source-stated one-5090 route, its 22.1-fps claim, retiming, prequeue, square-canvas, and interaction limits.
